description_en: Retrieves the share URL for Query Governance
description_zh: 调用GetQueryOptimizeShareUrl接口，获取查询治理的分享链接
name: GetQueryOptimizeShareUrl

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL: RDS MySQL
PolarDBMySQL: PolarDB for MySQL
PostgreSQL: RDS PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

MySQL：RDS MySQL
PolarDBMySQL：PolarDB MySQL版
PostgreSQL：RDS PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，多个实例ID间用逗号分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The keywords in the SQL text. Separate multiple keywords with spaces
parameters.help_zh: SQL文本关键词，多个关键词以空格分隔
parameters.name: keywords

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship between multiple keywords in the SQL text. Valid values:

or: The OR logical relationship.
and: The AND logical relationship
parameters.help_zh:
多个SQL文本关键词的逻辑关系。

or：或。
and：与
parameters.name: logical_operator

parameters.help_en: The rules to be filtered. Separate multiple rules with commas. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/290038.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要过滤的规则，多个规则以逗号分隔。具体信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/290038.html
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en: The names of the databases to be queried
parameters.name: db_names

parameters.help_en: The date when the data is queried. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的日期，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page in a paging query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询每页最大记录数，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the paging query. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码，从1开始，默认为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Default value: count. Valid values:

count: The number of executions.
maxQueryTime: The maximum execution time.
avgQueryTime: The average execution time.
maxLockTime: The maximum lock wait time.
avgLockTime: The average lock wait time.
maxRowsExamined: The maximum number of scanned rows.
avgRowsExamined: The average number of scanned rows.
maxRowsSent: The maximum number of returned rows.
avgRowsSent: The average number of returned rows
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认为count。

count：执行次数。
maxQueryTime：最大执行时间。
avgQueryTime：平均执行时间。
maxLockTime：最大锁等待时间。
avgLockTime：平均锁等待时间。
maxRowsExamined：最大扫描行数。
avgRowsExamined：平均扫描行数。
maxRowsSent：最大返回行数。
avgRowsSent：平均返回行数
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the results in ascending order. Default value: true. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否升序排序，默认为true。

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the SQL statements that need to be optimized. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询待优化的SQL，默认为false。

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: only_optimized_sql

parameters.help_en: The SQL template IDs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/405261.html operation to query the SQL template IDs
parameters.help_zh: SQL模板ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/405261.html接口查询SQL模板ID
parameters.name: sql_ids

parameters.help_en:
The region where the instance resides. Valid values:

cn-china: The Chinese mainland.
cn-hongkong: Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Singapore.

This parameter is valid only when the InstanceIds request parameter is empty. If the InstanceIds request parameter is empty, data is retrieved based on the region specified by the Region parameter, and the default region is cn-china. If the InstanceIds request parameter is not empty, data is retrieved based on the region of the first instance specified in InstanceIds, regardless of the value of the Region parameter.

For instances created in regions in the Chinese mainland, set this parameter to cn-china
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属地域，取值：

cn-china：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：中国香港。
ap-southeast-1：新加坡。

此参数只有在请求参数InstanceIds为空时有效。如果请求参数InstanceIds为空时，按照Region参数设置的地域获取数据，系统默认实例所属地域为cn-china；如果请求参数InstanceIds不为空时，即使设置了Region参数，也以InstanceIds所传入的第一个实例所在地域为准获取数据。

在中国内地各地域创建的实例，传入此参数时，都为cn-china
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The database account to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的数据库账号
parameters.name: user

The returned message.
If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。

false：执行失败
